Package com.agrialert.data_manager

Class AlertTypeCrossRef

java.lang.Object
com.agrialert.data_manager.AlertTypeCrossRef
class AlertTypeCrossRef extends Object
Represents a cross-reference join table between AlertType and Field. This entity establishes a many-to-many relationship, allowing specific alert configurations to be associated with different fields, including customizable threshold values. This class should not be exposed outside its package.

The primary key is a composite of fieldId and alertTypeId.
